'''Meier "Maks" Eidelheit'''
(<!-- {{small|Polish:}} {{IPAc-pl|AUD|Pl-Stefan_Banach.ogg|'|s|t|e|f|a|n|-|'|b|a|n|a|x}}; -->6 July 1910 – March 1943)
was a [[Polish people|Polish]] [[mathematician]] belonging to the [[Lwów School of Mathematics]] who worked in [[Lwów]] and was murdered in the [[Holocaust]].

==Biography==
Meier Eidelheit left the Lwów [[Gymnasium (school)|Gymnasium]] in 1929 and then studied mathematics at the scientific faculty in [[Lwów]], completing his <!-- undergraduate? --> study in 1933 with a thesis on the theory of [[summation]].
In 1938, with [[Stefan Banach]] as supervisor, he gained a [[doctorate]] from the Jan-Kazimierz-[[Lviv University|University of Lwów]] with a [[Dissertation]] ''über die Auflösbarkeit eines linearen Gleichungssystems mit unendlich vielen Unbekannten''.<ref name="Maligranda">{{cite web
 |url=http://atlas-conferences.com/c/b/e/g/34.htm
 |title= Topology Atlas: Meier (Maks) Eidelheit (1910–1943)
 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20150402142919/http://atlas-conferences.com/c/b/e/g/34.htm |archive-date= 2015-04-02
 |author-first= Lech | author-last= Maligranda
 }}</ref>
From 1933 to 1939 he gave private lectures;
from 31 January 1939 onwards he was an Assistant Professor of [[Mathematical analysis|Analysis]],
from 21 March 1941 he was candidate for a professorship<!-- ''Anwärter'' auf den wissenschaftlichen Rang eines Professors -->.<ref>{{cite web
 |author=Ярослав Григорович Притула
 |url=https://www.franko.lviv.ua/faculty/mechmat/history/meier.html
 |title= До 100-річчя з Дня народження Айдельгайт Майєр
 |trans-title= On Meier Eidelheit's 100th Birthday
 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402111957/https://www.franko.lviv.ua/faculty/mechmat/history/meier.html |archive-date=2015-04-02 |access-date=2016-02-22
 |language=uk }} (with picture)</ref>
He worked mainly on [[Functional analysis]].
On the basis of his 1936 paper on [[convex set]]s in linear [[normed space]]s,
geometric versions of the [[hyperplane separation theorem]] are also known (in German) as ''Trennungssatz von Eidelheit'' (Eidelheit separation theorem).<ref name="Eidelheit 1936a"/><ref>{{cite book
 |author-first= Peter  |author-last= Kosmol
 |title= Optimierung und Approximation
 |trans-title= Optimisation and Approximation
 |language= de
 |publisher= [[Walter de Gruyter]] |year= 2010 |isbn= 978-3-11-021814-5 |chapter= 11.3: ''Trennungssatz von Eidelheit''}}</ref>
A theorem on the solubility of certain infinite systems of equations in [[Fréchet spaces]] is also named after him.<ref>{{cite book
 |author= R. Meise |author2= D. Vogt
 |title= Einführung in die Funktionalanalysis
 |trans-title= Introduction to functional analysis
 |language= de
 |publisher= Vieweg |year= 1992 |isbn= 3-528-07262-8 }}, Satz 26.27 ''Satz von Eidelheit''</ref>

Eidelheit published six papers in ''[[Studia Mathematica]]'' from 1936 to 1940;<ref name="Eidelheit 1936a">{{cite journal
 |author-first= M. |author-last= Eidelheit
 |title= Zur Theorie der konvexen Mengen in linearen normierten Räumen |language= de
 |trans-title= On the theory of [[convex set]]s in linear [[normed space]]s
 |url= http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/sm/sm6/sm6111.pdf
 |journal= [[Studia Mathematica]] |volume= 6 |year= 1936 |pages= 104–111}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 |author-first= M. |author-last= Eidelheit
 |title= Über lineare Gleichungen in separablen Räumen |language= de
 |trans-title= On linear equations in separable spaces
 |url= http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/sm/sm6/sm6113.pdf
 |journal= [[Studia Mathematica]] |volume= 6 |year= 1936 |pages= 117–138}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 |author-first= M. |author-last= Eidelheit
 |title= Zur Theorie der Systeme linearer Gleichungen |language= de
 |trans-title= On the theory of systems of linear equations
 |url= http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/sm/sm6/sm6114.pdf
 |journal= [[Studia Mathematica]] |volume= 6 |year= 1936 |pages= 139–148}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 |author-first= M. |author-last= Eidelheit
 |title= Zur Theorie der Systeme linearer Gleichungen (II) |language= de
 |trans-title= On the theory of systems of linear equations (II)
 |url= http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/sm/sm7/sm7114.pdf
 |journal= [[Studia Mathematica]] |volume= 7 |year= 1938 |pages= 150–154–}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 |author-first= M. |author-last= Eidelheit
 |title= Über lineare Gleichungen in separablen Räumen (II) |language= de
 |trans-title= On linear equations in separable spaces (II)
 |url= http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/sm/sm8/sm8110.pdf
 |journal= [[Studia Mathematica]] |volume= 8 |year= 1939 |pages= 154–169}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 |author-first= M. |author-last= Eidelheit
 |title= On isomorphisms of rings of linear operators
 |url= http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/sm/sm9/sm917.pdf
 |journal= [[Studia Mathematica]] |volume= 9 |year= 1940 |pages= 97–105 }}</ref> a seventh was printed posthumously.<ref name="Eidelheit 1948">{{cite journal
 |author-first= M. |author-last= Eidelheit
 |title= Quelques remarques sur les fonctionelles linéaires |language=fr
 |trans-title= Some remarks on [[linear functionals]]
 |url= http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/sm/sm10/sm10111.pdf
 |journal= [[Studia Mathematica]] |volume= 10 |year= 1948 |pages= 140–147 }}</ref> Eidelheit was an active contributor to the ''[[Scottish Book]]'', posing problems 172, 173, 174, 176 and 188<ref>{{cite journal
 |author=L. Maligranda |author2= V. Mykhaylyuk |author3= A. Plichko
 |title=On a problem of Eidelheit from The Scottish Book concerning absolutely continuous functions
 |journal= Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications |url= http://urn.kb.se/resolve?urn=urn:nbn:se:ltu:diva-14958|doi=10.1016/j.jmaa.2010.09.027
 |series= [[J. Math. Anal. Appl.]]
 |volume= 375 |issue= 2 |year= 2011 |pages= 401–411 |s2cid= 54991057 |doi-access= free }}</ref>
and answering problem 26 ([[Stanisław Mazur|Mazur]]), 64 (Mazur),<ref name="Eidelheit 1936a"/><ref>{{cite journal
 |author= Kakutani, S.
 |title= Ein Beweis des Satzes von Eidelheit über konvexe Mengen |journal= Proceedings of the Japan Academy, Series A, Mathematical Sciences |language=de
 |trans-title= A proof of Eidelheit's theorem on convex sets
 |url= https://projecteuclid.org/download/pdf_1/euclid.pja/1195579980
 |series= Proceedings of the Imperial Academy of Japan |volume= 13 |year= 1937 |issue= 4 |pages= 93–94 |doi= 10.3792/pia/1195579980 |doi-access= free }}</ref> 162 ([[Hugo Steinhaus|Steinhaus]]), and 176 (Eidelheit).

Meier Eidelheit was murdered in the [[Holocaust]] in March 1943.
His posthumously published article ''Quelques remarques sur les fonctionelles linéaires'' in volume 10 of the [[Studia Mathematica]] was prefaced with the following lines:
"L’auteur de ce travail a été assassiné par les Allemands en mars de 1943. Le manuscrit qu’il fut parvenir à la Rédaction en 1941 a été retrouvé récemment entre les papiers laissés par S. Banach."
(in English: The author of this work was murdered in March 1943 by the Germans.
The manuscript, which reached the editors in 1941, was recently found among the writings left by S. Banach.)<ref name="Eidelheit 1948"/>
